item.title: Dinner at a friend's house
item.context_text: Your friend Malika invites you to dinner with her family on Saturday. You answer her, find out what to bring, and say hello to her family at the door.
item.objective_text: Accept the invitation, ask what to bring, and greet your friend's father politely.
item.target_grammar: Can I…? for offers and requests (Can I bring something?)
item.cultural_note: In Uzbekistan guests often bring bread (non), sweets or fruit when they visit a family. In many other countries guests bring flowers or a dessert.
success_conditions: Understand the day and time of the dinner
Say yes, say thank you and ask what to bring
Greet Malika's father and give your present

children.title: Read Malika's invitation
children.instructions: Read Malika's message. Then answer the questions.
children.prompt_text: Malika: Hi! Can you come to dinner at my house on Saturday? My mum is making plov! Dinner is at 7 pm. My dad can meet you at the bus stop.

children.title: Answer Malika
children.instructions: Answer Malika. Say yes, say thank you, and ask what you can bring.
children.prompt_text: Malika: Can you come on Saturday?
children.goal: Accept the invitation, thank Malika and ask what to bring.
children.model_answer: Yes, I can come! Thank you very much. What can I bring? Can I bring some fruit or a cake?

children.title: Listen to Malika
children.instructions: Malika answers with a voice message. Listen. Then answer the questions. You can listen again.
children.prompt_text: Hi! Thank you for your message. Please don't bring a big present. Maybe some bread from the bazaar? My grandmother lives with us too. She doesn't speak English, but she is very friendly. See you at seven!

questions.explanation: Malika says "Maybe some bread from the bazaar?"

children.title: Say hello at the door
children.instructions: You arrive at Malika's house. Her father opens the door. Say hello, say who you are, and give him the bread.
children.prompt_text: Malika's father: Good evening! Come in, come in!
children.goal: Greet Malika's father, say who you are and give your present.
children.model_answer: Hello, good evening! I am Aziz, Malika's friend. Thank you for inviting me. This bread is for you.
